## Beast Demon (Chaaor) (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
CE Large outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +24  

**Defense**

 **AC** 24, touch 14, flat-footed 21 (+3 Dex, +10 natural, –1 size, +2 profane)  
**hp** 126 (11d10+66)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +10, **Will** +5  
**DR** 10/good; **Immune** electricity, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 22  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +19 (1d8+8 plus grab), bite +18 (2d6+8)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** rend (2 claws, 1d8+8), roar (3/day, 60-ft. radius, Reflex DC 21 half, 3d6 sonic damage)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 11th)  

 At will—darkness, greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), see invisibility  
1/day—chaos hammer (DC 16), summon (level 9, 2d4 dretches or 1 chaaor 35%)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 17, **Con** 22, **Int** 8, **Wis** 14,**Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +11; **CMB** +20 (+24 grapple); **CMD** 35  
**Feats** Awesome Blow, Blind-Fight, Cleave, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  
**Skills** Climb +22, Intimidate +16, Perception +24, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +13; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Perception  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common; telepathy 100 ft.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Abyss)  
**Organization** solitary, gang (2–5), or pack (6–11)  
**Treasure** standard
